findings.evidence: "## Interview" restates the universally known standup question list (yesterday/today/blockers/topics) as activation content, roughly a third of the body
findings.fix: Compress the four interview questions into a single line and keep only the expert rules (grouping, outcome-vs-investigation distinction)

findings.evidence: "Group duplicate activity appearing in session history, commits, PRs, Jira, and answers by work item" — no procedure for reconciling contradictions between user answers and approved activity
findings.fix: Add: if approved activity contradicts an answer (e.g. user says no blockers but commits suggest stalled work), surface the discrepancy and ask before including it

findings.evidence: "Never claim an investigation as completed delivery." — several Never items are bare imperatives without the non-obvious why
findings.fix: Append a one-clause reason to each item (e.g. investigations reported as done inflate status and mislead sprint tracking)

findings.evidence: "python3 scripts/claude_digest.py --format json" — the script offers text and json output but no stated default for which the agent should run
findings.fix: State: always run claude_digest.py with --format json and render the summary yourself

findings.evidence: digest invocation has no branch for an empty result (session_count 0, missing ~/.claude/projects, or a non-Claude harness); the script returns silently empty
findings.fix: Add: if the digest reports zero sessions, say so once and continue with the interview
